drums.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time, A resonant, syncopated synth bassline provides a constant rhythmic pulse, High-frequency metallic percussion and sharp, closed hi-hats cut through the mix with sixteenth-note patterns, A dark, detuned lead synth enters with a repetitive, minor-key melodic hook, Industrial sound effects, including mechanical clangs and white noise sweeps, are layered throughout, The track features a dense, compressed production style with aggressive saturation on the low end and a wide stereo field for the atmospheric pads Publish

bass.description: Nu-disco and synth-pop track at 120 BPM in the key of G minor, The arrangement features a prominent slap bass line playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns, A four-on-the-floor kick drum and a crisp snare on beats 2 and 4 drive the rhythm, accompanied by sixteenth-note closed hi-hats, Bright, staccato analog synth chords provide rhythmic stabs on the off-beats, A clean, funk-style electric guitar plays muted rhythmic scratches and occasional melodic fills, Shimmering synth pads with a slow filter sweep provide harmonic texture in the background, The track uses a polished, modern production style with sidechain compression on the pads and bass, keyed to the kick drum, Handclaps reinforce the snare during transition sections, A resonant lead synth with a slight portamento performs a melodic hook in the higher register Publish
